section: Marking a Peer as a Static Slow Peer Using a Peer Policy Template
commands:
1. enable
2. configure terminal
3. router bgp autonomous-system-number
4. template peer-policy policy-template-name
5. slow-peer split-update-group static
6. exit
7. address-family ipv4
8. neighbor ip-address inherit peer-policy policy-template-name
examples:
Router> enable
Router# configure terminal
Router(config)# router bgp 5
Router(config-router)# template peer-policy global
Router(config-router-ptmp)# slow-peer split-update-group static
Router(config-router-ptmp)# exit
Router(config-router)# address-family ipv4
Router(config-router-af)# neighbor 10.0.0.1 inherit peer-policy global

configuration_guide: IP Routing Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS XE 17.x
chapter: BGP - Configuring a BGP Route Server
section: Configure a Route Server with Flexible Policy Handling
commands:
1. enable
2. configure terminal
3. router bgp autonomous-system-number
4. route-server-context context-name
5. description string
6. address-family { ipv4 | ipv6 } { unicast | multicast }
7. import-map route-map-name
8. exit-address-family
9. exit-route-server-context
10. exit
11. ip as-path access-list access-list-number { permit | deny } regexp
12. route-map route-map-name [ permit | deny ] sequence-number
13. match as-path access-list-number
14. exit
15. router bgp autonomous-system-number
16. neighbor { ipv4-address | ipv6-address } remote-as remote-as-number
17. address-family { ipv4 | ipv6 } { unicast | multicast }
18. neighbor { ipv4-address | ipv6-address } activate
19. neighbor { ipv4-address | ipv6-address } route-server-client context ctx-name
20. end
examples:
Router> enable
Router# configure terminal
Router(config)# router bgp 900
Router(config-router)# route-server-context ONLY_AS27_CONTEXT
Router(config-router-rsctx)# description Permit only routes with AS 27 in AS path.
Router(config-router-rsctx)# address-family ipv4 unicast
Router(config-router-rsctx-af)# import-map only_AS27_routemap
Router(config-router-rsctx-af)# exit-address-family
Router(config-router-rsctx)# exit-route-server-context
Router(config-router)# exit
Router(config)# ip as-path access-list 5 permit 27
Router(config)# route-map only_AS27_routemap permit 10
Router(config-route-map)# match as-path 5
Router(config-route-map)# exit
Router(config)# router bgp 900
Router(config-router)# neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 500
Router(config-router)# address-family ipv4 unicast
Router(config-router-af)# neighbor 10.0.0.1 activate
Router(config-router-af)# neighbor 10.0.0.1 route-server-client context ONLY_AS27_CONTEXT
Router(config-router-af)# end

commands:

6. template
7. ip access-group { access-list-number | name } { in | out }
8. exit
9. interface interface-id
10. ip access-group { access-list-number | name } { in | out }
11. source template name
12. end
examples:
Device> enable
Device# configure terminal
Device(config)# ip access-list extended 150
Device(config)# ip access-list extended 151
Device(config-ext-nacl)# exit
Device# template test
Device(config-template)# ip access-group 150 in
Device(config-template)# exit
Device(config)# interface gigabitethernet1/0/1
Device(config-if)# ip access-group 151 out
Device(config)# source template test
Device(config)# end

section: Configuring VLAN Maps - Procedure

8. end

Device(config-access-map)# exit

Device(config)# end

section: Creating a Network Object Group - Procedure

section: Creating an Object-Group-Based ACL - Procedure
commands:
1. enable
2. configure terminal
3. ip access-list extended access-list-name
4. remark remark
5. deny protocol source [ source-wildcard ] destination [ destination-wildcard ] [ option option-name ] [ precedence precedence ] [ tos tos ] [ established ] [ log | log-input ] [ time-range time-range-name ] [ fragments ]
6. remark remark
7. permit protocol source [ source-wildcard ] destination [ destination-wildcard ] [ option option-name ] [ precedence precedence ] [ tos tos ] [ established ] [ log | log-input ] [ time-range time-range-name ] [ fragments ]
8. Repeat the steps to specify the fields and values on which you want to base your access list.
9. end
examples:
Device> enable
Device# configure terminal
Device(config)# ip access-list extended nomarketing
Device(config-ext-nacl)# remark protect server by denying access from the Marketing network
Device(config-ext-nacl)# deny ip 209.165.200.244 255.255.255.224 host 209.165.200.245 log Example based on object-group:
Router(config)# object-group network my_network_object_group
Router(config-network-group)# 209.165.200.224 255.255.255.224
Router(config-network-group)# exit
Router(config)# object-group network my_other_network_object_group
Router(config-network-group)# host 209.165.200.245
Router(config-network-group)# exit
Router(config)# ip access-list extended nomarketing
Router(config-ext-nacl)# deny ip object-group my_network_object_group object-group my_other_network_object_group log
Device(config-ext-nacl)# remark allow TCP from any source to any destination
Device(config-ext-nacl)# permit tcp any any
Device(config-ext-nacl)# end
